title: The emphasized bar, badged then lit

aliases.name: emphasize == the spotlight's / punch's datum index

members.role: the bars page states the comparison and carries its badge and its `emphasize` index on the answer bar
the page's own badge stamps with the page, naming the answer bar before the light finds it
the feathered light lands on the datum whose index equals `emphasize` (Tokyo does the same with a punch)

does: The comparison's answer bar is badged as the page builds, then lit seven and a half seconds later - the light always lands on the bar the page already marked as the answer.
